get_source_dir: get the absolute path of the directory where gmock test .py files reside
get_test_executable_path: get the absolute path of a gmock test binary given its executable name
get_exit_status: extract the exit status code from an os.system result across Windows and Unix
run_subprocess: run a subprocess using the gmock Subprocess utility class for test execution
run_main_tests: run the gmock unit test suite by calling the Main entry point function
